verdict.rationale: Scoped or least-privilege credentials are a fair question for an agent framework like AutoGen, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no way to issue scoped API credentials for an agent. Docker-based code execution isolation and tool use are related controls, not credential scoping, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
